notes: AIDao v1.0.1 GitHub App authentication test build. Adds a repository-scoped GitHub App Device Flow path that uses only the public GitHub App Client ID in the APK; no GitHub App private key, client secret, or long-lived personal access token is embedded or persisted. The validated v1.0 creation workspace, isolated generated branches, trusted repository_dispatch CI, local deterministic generation, user-controlled source overrides, bounded repair, and zero-required-service-cost policy remain intact. GitHub authorization and permission failures are translated into concise human-readable guidance instead of exposing raw API JSON in the new GitHub App build path.
